Subject: Request: Exceptional Offer Authorization — Senior Inference Engineer (Sofia Martinez)

Team,

We have an expedited situation for Sofia Martinez (ex-NeuralEdge lead on model infra). She completed loop last week; hiring manager and IC bar are green. Compensation alignment: she’s requesting a $45k sign-on + an equity refresh to match retention expectations. The role is Senior Inference Engineer (IC4) — band top is $290k base + 0.6% equity typical. Sofia is asking for: 1) base at $300k, 2) $45k sign-on (split over 12 months), and 3) 0.8% refresh because of counter-offer risk.

Rationale: candidate has direct production inference experience at scale, owns several kernel-level optimizations, and is a known flight risk (multiple offers live). Hiring manager has budget for base uplift but not for both the refresh and sign-on at the requested levels without an exception. We need alignment on: out-of-band base, approval for sign-on amount, and approval for equity refresh.

Attachments: proposed_offer_Sofia_Martinez_v2.pdf (redline of offer), comp_grid_2027_Q3.xlsx (band and budget impact).

Ask: Approve an exception to allow this combo (base to $300k AND sign-on $45k AND 0.8% refresh) or provide a clear counter authority limit (e.g., approve one item only). We need a decision by EOD Tuesday 9/14 to keep offer cadence.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exceptional Offer Authorization — Senior Inference Engineer (Sofia Martinez)

David — thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Quick notes:

- Base: bump to $300k is outside comp committee guideline but plausible given market and candidate level. Need to confirm hiring manager funding source (H1: team remaining headcount/bonus pool).
- Sign-on: $45k is large but could be structured (50% upfront, 50% 12-mo retention).
- Equity: 0.8% feels high for IC4; typical refreshs are 0.4–0.6%. If we do 0.8%, we should add a 12-month graded vest for refresh to protect company.

Can Marcus and Rishi weigh in on precedent and finance impact? If we approve all three, I want a short memo attached for exec records.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP People Operations
Redwood Inference

+1 to Laura's notes. A few data points from compensation:
- Market comps: recent external comp comp report shows median for like-for-like senior inference is $285–305k total cash in this geography (SF Bay).
- Equity: 0.8% would push this hire into the low director-equivalent range on a fully-diluted basis; we've only authorized similar refreshes where strategic single contributors were critical to roadmap.
- Precedent: In Q2 we granted a 0.7% refresh to a Staff LLM infra hire (unique case).

Recommendation: Approve sign-on $45k with a clawback/retention schedule (50/50), approve base at $298k (compromise), and cap refresh at 0.6% with 12-mo graded vest. That keeps us competitive while controlling runway. If Hiring Manager pushes, allow Marcus to approve up to 0.65% with CFO sign-off for 0.66–0.8%.

-Rishi
Head of Total Rewards
